newsitem.title: UK: NMT Group to list on UK's AIM market in April.
newsitem.headline: NMT Group to list on UK's AIM market in April.

text.p: NMT Group Plc, a medical devices company based in central Scotland, said on Friday it planned to list on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) in April via an institutional placing.
NMT, whose full name is New Medical Technology, plans to raise between 12.0 and 15.0 million stg with the issue, which is expected to value the company at 30.0 to 35.0 million stg.

It will use the proceeds to begin automated production of its automatic needle retraction technology. The group, based in the EuroMed Business Park in Bellshill near Glasgow, has already begun small-scale production of the product.
NMT's products are designed to eliminate the risk of accidental injury to healthcare personnel from used needles and to improve the safety of injectable drug delivery systems.
The broker and nominated adviser to the issue is Panmure Gordon & Co Ltd.
